page.notes: Doubtful readings: the page number is printed in old form and may read 15 or 1s; numerals such as CCXLIIII, LXXXII I and LXXXVII are hard to read and marked [?]; "eligeren" at p.58 is cut by the gutter and is uncertain. Long s has been written as plain s throughout (e.g. "sunt" for the printed form in the first paragraph). Entries are set two per line in the scan and are shown as printed, separated by " | ". Greek: none. Marginal notes: none.
